versions.changelog:
Initial release — design-integration skill for Uniswap architecture blueprints.

- Provides project-specific Uniswap integration blueprints, covering method recommendations, architecture patterns, dependencies, security review, and implementation plan.
- Activates on user requests for Uniswap integration design or recommendations.
- Extracts parameters (project type, functionality, environment, chains, scale) from user prompts.
- Delegates design tasks to integration-architect agent; does not call MCP tools directly.
- Outputs tailored, structured architecture plans with rationale, error handling, and complexity assessment.
- Includes robust error handling for incomplete or conflicting user input.
